title: Daily Reflection - Homeward Practice

blocks.label: Text: Noticing God in your day.
Text: Set aside seven to ten quiet minutes near the end of the day. This pract…
blocks.value: Set aside seven to ten quiet minutes near the end of the day. This practice is rooted in the ancient Examen. It is not a scorecard. It is a way of learning your life with God.

blocks.label: Text: Place your feet on the floor. Let your shoulders soften. Take one slow b…
blocks.value: Place your feet on the floor. Let your shoulders soften. Take one slow breath.

blocks.label: Text: Name one gift from the day. Make it small and concrete: a face, a meal, …
blocks.value: Name one gift from the day. Make it small and concrete: a face, a meal, a moment of beauty, a completed task, or needed rest.

blocks.label: Text: Replay the day gently. Where did you feel open, alive, loving, or free? …
blocks.value: Replay the day gently. Where did you feel open, alive, loving, or free? Where did you tighten, hide, rush, or resist love?

blocks.label: Text: Speak honestly with God. Receive mercy where you missed the way and deli…
blocks.value: Speak honestly with God. Receive mercy where you missed the way and delight where grace was present.

blocks.label: Text: Name one small response for tomorrow: a conversation, boundary, apology,…
blocks.value: Name one small response for tomorrow: a conversation, boundary, apology, act of care, or moment of attention.

blocks.label: Heading: Try this for seven evenings.
Text: Look for patterns of grace, resistance, fatigue, desire, and love - not …
blocks.value: Look for patterns of grace, resistance, fatigue, desire, and love - not a perfect day.

meta_description: A gentle Examen practice for noticing God, grace, and love in an ordinary day.
